confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for a July 2026 window, with no live listings checked. Restaurant and food anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely with summer demand and events. Drinks are estimated from typical Spanish coastal tourist pricing. The FX figure comes from search-result summaries of the RBA page, which I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Spanish Basque and northern coastal tourist cities, such as Bilbao and Santander, adjusted upward for San Sebastian's high peak-summer lodging demand and pintxos-bar pricing.
